## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and the problem it solves.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] Application E2E check, when the interface or browser behavior changes
- [ ] Dark and light themes; English and Arabic layouts
- [ ] No browsing data, credentials, or private release tooling committed
- [ ] Documentation and Unreleased changelog updated
- [ ] Version unchanged unless this is an explicitly planned release

## Review notes

List limitations, security considerations, and follow-up work. Attach interface
captures when relevant. Passing checks are required before merging.
